messages:
Maya: Morning — quick async check. Onboarding synthiaV4-smallq: spotlight eval shows a regression on spanish promptset (taxonomy F1 -6pts). Uploaded full logs to gs://redwood-evals/synthiaV4/171546/ — @Srija can you triage?
Srija: On it. Can you paste one failing example here so I can run a focused repro?
Maya: Sure — minimal failing case below: 
```
prompt: "Clasifica este texto: ¿Cuál es la categoría?
Texto: 'El plan incluye seguro dental y vision.'
Respuesta esperada: 'beneficios'
model: synthiaV4-smallq (quant-8)
output: 'salud'
```
Srija: Hmm looks like a tokenization boundary shift — output maps to nearest semantically similar label. Any recent tokenizer or vocab changes?
Noah: I pushed a quant tweak yesterday (PR #5108) that adjusted pad id handling for smallq. Could be side-effect. I can repro locally in a sec.
Lucas: FYI I rolled forward a staging hotfix that reverts pad handling at 07:10 UTC, kicking off a rerun of the spanish promptset.
deploy-bot: deploy <revert-pad-handling> finished on staging (id: dc3f9a) — tests triggered: synthiaV4-smallq/spanish-promptset 
Srija: Thanks. If staging rerun looks good can we gate the onboard? Also flagging this for model-gating checklists (possible quant mismatch).
Maya: Agreed — holding the onboard rollout until we confirm. Action items: Noah to run a focused repro + diff of tokenizer outputs, Srija to verify rerun logs, Lucas to hold next deploy.
Noah: Repro started. Quick local snippet I'm running: 
```
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.load('synthiaV4-vocab')
print(t.encode("El plan incluye seguro dental y vision."))
```
Noah: First pass shows off-by-one on a space token with quant-8 path. I'll open a PR if confirmed.
Lucas: If PR needed, ping me for a fast rollback-on-failure policy in Dedicated.
Maya: Also pinging @oncall-ml for visibility. Planning to post a short status update in an hour. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Srija: tl;dr — triage in progress, holding onboarding, expect update in ~45m. :thumbsup:
